name: Captain Vega
description: Marine Captain leading the fortress garrison. The first real boss most players face.
strategy: Stay mobile during his charge. He has long startup on the overhead — punish with M1s, then disengage.

name: Tomb Guardian
description: Stone construct of the desert tombs. Slow but punishing — one hit can delete careless players.
strategy: Bait its slam attack, then circle behind. Sea Blade trivializes the fight.

name: Storm Lord
description: Master of skyborne lightning. The gatekeeper between the Second and Third Sea.
strategy: Phase 2 begins at 50%. Avoid open ground — his global lightning targets the highest elevation.

name: Glacier Tyrant
description: Ancient ice beast that froze its own kingdom. Drops the Ice Fruit awakening trigger.
strategy: Stack on its left flank — its primary breath cone covers the right side.

name: Cursed Captain
description: Bound to the cursed deck of his ship for centuries. Drops the Cursed Saber.
strategy: His phantom adds heal him — kill them before pressing the boss. Armament Haki is mandatory in P2.

name: Saber Expert
description: Drops the legendary Shisui. Spawns randomly across the Third Sea — chase the announcement.
strategy: Parry-heavy fight. Bring a teammate with CC — solo kills require sub-2000 ms reactions.

name: Ocean Tyrant
description: Endgame raid boss. Six-player encounter with three phases and an enrage at 10%.
strategy: Phase 1: dodge the wave. Phase 2: split the raid into two pillars. Phase 3: stack and burn — enrage hits at 10% HP.

name: Fallen Admiral
description: Once a marine admiral, now a fallen monster. The raid's hardest hitter.
strategy: The Admiral's hitscan is the highest in the game. Line-of-sight breaks save lives.
